code.layout: cats 0..d-1, ancillas d..2d-2; stabilizer j = X_j X_{j+1}; CX(ancilla j -> cat j) then (-> cat j+1)

provenance.preset: presets/allcat.yaml (every literature number with its page and equation)
provenance.cycle: LR23 Sec. 3 / GO23 App. D: prep, CNOT, refresh, CNOT, M_X, each 1/kappa2 = 100 ns (kappa2/2pi = 1.59 MHz, GO23 p. 4)
provenance.cx_channel[Z]: LR23 Eqs. (3)-(4): Z_a = |a|^2 kappa1 T + 0.159/(|a|^2 kappa2 T), Z_d = Z_aZ_d = |a|^2 kappa1 T/2, T = 1/kappa2
provenance.cx_channel[bit flips]: LR23 p. 8 and GO23 Eq. (D8): 0.5 exp(-2|a|^2) summed over 12 bit-flip-type Paulis; split equally among them (assumption: no published split at T = 1/kappa2)
provenance.p_data: idle Z |a|^2 kappa1 T per step (LR23 pp. 7-8, CH22 Eq. (D4)) for 3 steps (4 for the two boundary cats, idle during the other CNOT layer), so that every cat has 5 |a|^2 eta per round (LR23 p. 8); idle X = Y = 0.5 kappa1 |a|^2 T exp(-4|a|^2) per step (CH22 Table II)
provenance.f_mid: 1/3: the refreshing step lies between a data cat's two CNOTs (LR23 Fig. 4 inset)
provenance.p_prep/p_meas: ancilla preparation, refresh and X measurement each |a|^2 kappa1 T (LR23 pp. 7-8); data readout the same
provenance.p_data_meas_z: well (Z) readout exp(-1.5 - 0.9 |a|^2) (CH22 Eq. (38), T_measure ~ 850 ns)
provenance.thermal: kappa1 -> kappa1 (1 + 2 n_th) (CH22 App. D), n_th = 0.0
provenance.leakage: none: with T = 1/kappa2 and refreshing steps the leakage stays below the bit-flip probability (LR23 Sec. 2.3)
provenance.heralds: data bit-flip heralds with efficiency 0.5 (buffer emission, Ferrari et al., arXiv:2607.01375; shown for idle flips, assumed here for gate flips)
provenance.validation: reproduces the circuit-level logical phase-flip fit of LR23 Fig. 4b (examples/literature_checks_models.py)
provenance.herald_efficiency: herald efficiency 0.5: of the order of our estimate for gate-induced errors in the hybrid cell (36-53% heralded at a useful false-herald rate, paper App. I); every bit flip of a stabilized dissipative cat comes with a buffer-emission burst (Ferrari et al., arXiv:2607.01375); no calculation for the all-cat CNOT; false heralds are not modelled (a herald is always a real flip)

generator.sampler: stim.FlipSimulator + leakage in the incoherent approximation (dem/noise_models.py)

layout.heralds: round-major; per round the d-1 syndrome-erasure heralds of ancillas 0..d-2 (kind 1: ancilla found outside the qubit subspace, outcome random), then, if the model has them, the heralded bit flips of cats 0..d-1 (kind 2); the same bits are the herald detectors of detectors.b8, coordinates (x, round, kind); kind 0 = syndrome detectors
layout.leakage: rounds x (cats then ancillas) (round-major); 1 = leaked during that round

baseline_decoding.decoder: X basis: PyMatching 2 on the circuit DEM (leakage not in the DEM), correlated matching with the heralds; Z basis: none (no Z stabilizers), heralded cat bit flips undone
baseline_decoding.note: Z basis: the failure is the odd-parity probability of all cats, including the initial and final well readout
